b'# tinydl

A simple command-line tool for downloading data from URLs.

## Command Line Options

| Option | Short | Long | Description |
|--------|-------|------|-------------|
| `url` | - | - | what to download |
| `-o` | - | `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q` | - | `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Usage

```bash
tinydl <url> [-o <output_file>] [-q]
```

### Examples

```bash
# Download to stdout
tinydl https://example.com/data.txt

# Download to a file
tinydl https://example.com/data.txt -o data.txt

# Download silently
tinydl https://example.com/data.txt -q
```
'
